얇다.n: thin in thickness, for flat things like paper or clothes
cf: to be thin; to be slender (in diameter)
thin in width, like thread, fingers, or rain
to be thin; to be watery; to be dilute
liquid or soup that lacks thickness or strength
to be thin; to be flimsy; to be shallow
thin and slight; can also mean shallow or cheap, like a trick
to be thin; to be pale
light and faint, as thin cloth or pale color; somewhat literary

묻어나다.e: to rub off; to come off; to show through
묻어나다.n: something transfers onto another surface; figuratively feelings show
cf: to be stained; to be smeared
a stain or spot remains on a surface; also figuratively marred

강압적.n: forcing someone to obey by pressure or orders
cf: looking down and speaking from a position of superiority
suppressing freedom or expression of people, systems, or atmospheres
scaring others into silence by power, size, or manner

하다못해.e: even; if nothing else; at least
하다못해.n: names the minimum example, often with regret or wish
cf: adds a surprising extreme example to a list

와/과.n: Formal written particle with two forms chosen by the preceding sound.
cf: with; and (casual particle, after a vowel-ending noun)
Casual spoken particle attached after a noun ending in a consonant.
Neutral spoken particle that attaches to any noun regardless of its ending.
